name: The Fen Tiger
source: A reporter, on his last chance with his boss, is sent back to where he grew up to investigate a mysterious attack on a young girl. What he finds is that folk stories might be more than just legend...
translation: 一個記者好不容易才從上司那裡得到最後一次機會，被派回自己長大的地方，調查一起少女離奇遇襲的事件。他漸漸發現，那些民間故事恐怕不只是傳說……
